data.title: 卡提希娅 · 街角风车的修补
data.description: 小镇街角，卡提希娅穿栗色短斗篷坐在石栏边，仔细把折歪的纸风车叶片掰回原位。她举起风车等风吹来，看到它终于转动便开心抬眉，蓝眼与金发辫沐在明亮散射光里。
data.action: 修正纸风车叶片，举起来等风吹动。
data.promptProse: Cartethyia sits beside the town's stone railing, carefully straightening the folded blades of a paper pinwheel. Her chestnut cape covers a pale-blue tunic and cream trousers. She raises the toy to catch the breeze, blue eyes brightening when it finally spins beside her blonde braid. The medium portrait includes the corner paving and railing behind. Bright diffuse daylight reveals paper creases and cloak folds, with gentle stone-contact shadows below her hand.
